question: What is this permission set: licence, type, key system permissions, and how much does it grant?

steps.name: ps
steps.soql: SELECT Id, Name, Label, Type, License.Name, IsCustom, NamespacePrefix, PermissionsModifyAllData, PermissionsViewAllData, PermissionsApiEnabled, PermissionsCustomizeApplication, CreatedBy.Name, CreatedDate, LastModifiedBy.Name, LastModifiedDate FROM PermissionSet WHERE Name = '{permset}'

steps.name: objects
steps.soql: SELECT SobjectType, PermissionsRead, PermissionsEdit, PermissionsDelete FROM ObjectPermissions WHERE ParentId IN ({@ps.Id}) ORDER BY SobjectType

steps.name: fields
steps.soql: SELECT Field, PermissionsRead, PermissionsEdit FROM FieldPermissions WHERE ParentId IN ({@ps.Id}) ORDER BY Field

traps: Run on two orgs to see grant drift; a permission set deploy replaces the whole set, so drift here is what a deploy would overwrite.
